This section prepares your computer and gives you a mental model of the whole workflow. Start here even if LanCarbon is already installed. A successful launch only proves that the desktop application can run; Build and Publish use additional tools that are checked in their own windows.

After this section, you should know where LanCarbon stores data, what each external tool does, and where to find the main controls.

LanCarbon keeps the files it manages under one LanCarbon root folder. This makes the application easier to move, back up, inspect, and remove without scattering large caches and Book builds across the system drive.

records.content:
On a Windows computer with a D drive, the installer proposes:D:\LanCarbon

Choose this LanCarbon root, not its future Application child. The installer creates the child folders and installs the program at D:\LanCarbon\Application automatically.

If Windows has no D drive, the installer proposes a LanCarbon folder inside your current Windows user area. The directory page always shows the actual choice before installation.

For a first installation, two rules apply:

The final folder name must be exactly LanCarbon.

The selected LanCarbon folder must be empty.

Folder

Purpose

Backup priority

Application

LanCarbon program files and bundled resources.

Reinstallable; normally omit from a content-only backup.

Data

Notes, Books, page text, resource catalogs and research records.

Essential. This is your writing and management data.

Library

Original images, attachments and bibliography files under assets, plus Imports and AI-Paper materials.

Essential together with Data.

Config

Window preferences, the selected Data Location, and remembered Build and Export locations.

Recommended if you want the same setup after restoration.

Cache

Reusable runtime material, including the bundled Jupyter Book theme cache.

Optional; LanCarbon can recreate it.

Temp

Temporary Book preparation and GitHub publishing checkouts.

Do not back up. Completed operations remove their temporary working folders.

Builds

The default parent for local websites produced by Build.

Optional but useful when you want to keep built HTML. Source content remains in Data.

Exports

The default starting place for independent source copies made with Export.

Back up PDF files you want to keep.

Optional; keep for an offline migration or download again.

records.content:
Choosing a D- or E-drive root directs LanCarbon’s managed data, configuration, cache, temporary work, builds, PDFs, and Export starting location to that drive. Windows itself may still use the system drive briefly for installer bookkeeping, shortcuts, registry information, crash handling, or operating-system temporary activity. LanCarbon cannot redirect those Windows services, but it no longer chooses a C-drive application-data folder for its own persistent cache.

Environment Setup can keep Python, Node.js, Jupyter Book, Git, and GitHub CLI below Tools; manual system installations remain supported. Moving only Data does not move these tools. See Tools Required from Writing to Publishing for their installation and verification.

Choosing the Installation Location and Understanding LanCarbon Folders

records.content:
The safest complete backup is a copy of the entire LanCarbon root while the application is closed. For a smaller content backup, keep at least the actual Data location and root Library; include Config if you also want remembered locations and window preferences.

Before moving the root manually:

Close LanCarbon and wait for the window to disappear.

Copy the whole LanCarbon folder to the new drive.

Install LanCarbon into that existing root, or reinstall and select the copied root.

Open the application and verify several Notes, the Book table of contents, Resources, and Data Location before deleting the old copy.

Avoid moving individual files while LanCarbon is running. A Book can reference managed resources, and its Build and Publish records are stored with the workspace and configuration.

records.content:
选择 D 盘或 E 盘根目录后，LanCarbon 自己管理的数据、配置、缓存、临时发布文件、Build 结果、PDF 默认保存位置和 Export 起始位置都会优先位于所选磁盘。Windows 仍可能为了安装记录、快捷方式、注册信息、崩溃处理或系统临时操作而短暂使用系统盘，这些属于操作系统行为，LanCarbon 无法全部重定向。不过，LanCarbon 不再主动把自己的长期缓存放到 C 盘的应用数据目录中。

Environment Setup 可以把 Python、Node.js、Jupyter Book、Git 和 GitHub CLI 安装在 Tools 下，同时仍支持手动安装的系统工具。只迁移 Data 不会移动这些工具。安装与检查方法请阅读 Tools Required from Writing to Publishing。

选择安装位置并了解 LanCarbon 文件夹

records.content:
最稳妥的完整备份方式是在关闭软件后复制整个 LanCarbon 根目录。如果只备份写作内容，至少保留实际 Data 位置和根目录 Library；希望同时恢复记住的路径和窗口偏好时，再保留 Config。

手动迁移前建议按以下顺序操作：

关闭 LanCarbon，确认窗口已经完全消失。

把整个 LanCarbon 文件夹复制到新磁盘。

把软件安装到这个已有根目录，或重新安装并选择复制后的根目录。

打开软件，检查几篇 Notes、Book 目录、Resources 和 Data Location；确认无误后再处理旧副本。

不要在 LanCarbon 运行时移动其中的单个文件。Book 可能引用受管理资源，Build 和 Publish 记录也会与工作区及配置共同保存。

records.content:
程序位于 Application，写作数据位于同级的 Data。卸载前请先备份根目录。卸载完成后，在删除残留目录前先检查其中内容；保留下来的 Data、Builds、Exports 或 PDFs 仍可能包含需要的作品。

Original files are stored in root Library; Library/Workshop management records belong to the actual Data folder. See 

Browsing Your Library and 

Backup and recovery.

原始资料存放在根目录 Library，Library/Workshop 管理记录归属实际 Data 目录。详见 

浏览 Library 和 

备份与恢复。

The first-launch ReadMe introduces Environment Setup after the writing workspace is ready. You may begin writing immediately and open Setup when needed. Install tools only when you need Build or Publish; each item is independent and a failed download does not affect Notes or Books.
写作工作区准备完成后，首次启动 ReadMe 会介绍 Environment Setup。你可以直接开始写作，需要时再打开 Setup。只有需要 Build 或 Publish 时才安装相应工具；各项安装互相独立，下载失败不会影响 Notes 或 Books。

Download LanCarbon only from the project page or another source identified by the maintainer. The Windows installer has a name similar to LanCarbon-x.y.z-x64-Setup.exe; x.y.z is the version number. Keep the installer until you have confirmed that the application starts correctly.

Close any older LanCarbon window.

Run the installer and choose a destination. Installing over an older version is the normal upgrade method.

Start LanCarbon from the Start menu or the installation folder.

On first launch, wait for the main workspace to appear.

Select Data Location at the bottom of the sidebar and note the displayed folder.

LanCarbon stores Notes, Books, page order, Book settings, and managed Resources in that data location. Installing a new application version does not intentionally remove that folder. Before a major upgrade, copy the entire data folder to a safe backup location while LanCarbon is closed.

LanCarbon combines four tasks in one desktop interface:

Write ordinary Notes or structured Books.

Author Markdown and MyST with toolbar assistance.

Build a Book into a local Jupyter Book website.

Publish and later update that website through GitHub Pages.

LanCarbon works locally for writing. An account is not required until you publish. The current workflow is designed for Markdown/MyST pages; executable notebook editing and execution are outside this version’s main workflow.
Create a temporary Note, type one sentence, wait for All changes saved, close LanCarbon, and reopen it. If the sentence remains, local saving works. Delete the temporary Note afterward.
请只从项目主页或开发者明确提供的位置下载 LanCarbon。Windows 安装包名称类似 LanCarbon-x.y.z-x64-Setup.exe，其中 x.y.z 是版本号。在确认软件能够正常启动前，建议保留安装包。

关闭所有旧版本 LanCarbon 窗口。

运行安装包并选择安装位置。升级时直接覆盖旧版本是正常方式。

从开始菜单或安装目录启动 LanCarbon。

第一次启动时，等待主工作区完整显示。

点击侧边栏底部的 Data Location，记下显示的数据目录。

LanCarbon 会在 Data Location 中保存 Notes、Books、页面顺序、Book 设置和受管理的 Resources。安装新版软件不会主动删除这个目录。进行重要升级前，请先关闭 LanCarbon，再把整个数据目录复制到安全位置作为备份。

LanCarbon 在一个桌面界面中整合了四项工作：

撰写普通 Notes 或具有目录结构的 Books。

借助工具栏撰写 Markdown 和 MyST。

把 Book 构建成本地 Jupyter Book 网站。

通过 GitHub Pages 在线发布，并在以后更新网站。

写作本身完全在本地完成，不需要账号。只有 Publish 时才需要 GitHub。当前主要工作流面向 Markdown/MyST 页面；可执行 Notebook 的编辑与运行不属于这一版本的主要范围。
新建一篇临时 Note，输入一句话，等待顶部显示 All changes saved，关闭再重新打开 LanCarbon。如果句子仍然存在，说明本地保存正常。检查完成后可以删除这篇临时 Note。
The main workspace has four areas.

The workspace buttons form a 2×2 grid, with Notes / Books above Workshop / Library. Notes / Books switches between independent notes and structured Books. Press Ctrl+Q to switch quickly while keeping the selected Note or Book page; a Q hint is embedded at the right of the Books tab, with Ctrl+Q shown on hover and does not switch workspaces while a dialog is open.

Sort by orders the Notes list or Book selector by Last modified, Date created (newest first) or Name (A–Z). Pinned Notes stay first. Notes and Books remember their sorting choices independently across restarts. A Book’s last-modified time also includes edits to its pages; sorting the selector does not change the Book’s table of contents or export order.

The Book selector opens a different Book; the plus button creates one.

+ Section creates a top-level organizing page. + Child Page creates a page under the current selection.

Settings, Export, Build, Publish, and Delete operate on the selected Book.

The tree is the Book’s table of contents. Select a title to edit it. Click the separate triangle before a page to expand or collapse its children. Each Book remembers its folded branches across restarts. Navigating to a page from Preview or Build checks, or creating a child, automatically reveals its ancestors.

Light / Dark changes the application theme only.

Data Location shows or moves the application data folder.

All changes saved confirms that the latest text is on disk. Edit / Preview switches between Markdown source and rendered reading view. Press Ctrl+E on Windows or Cmd+E on macOS to switch quickly. Export PDF saves only the current Note or Markdown Book page as an A4 PDF, without its children. The default PDF destination is the PDFs folder beside Exports under the LanCarbon root. Installation or startup creates it automatically; you can still choose another destination. Exports remains for Book source copies, and existing PDFs are not moved. Page Properties opens export and page metadata. Remove from Book keeps the Note but removes it from this Book. The pin and trash controls pin or delete the current item.

The first toolbar row manages files and citations: Insert image, Image settings, Attach file, Resources, and Citations. Files can also be dropped or pasted into the editor.

The second row changes Markdown/MyST source: Undo, Redo, paragraph/heading, Bold, Italic, Underline, Strikethrough, superscript, subscript, alignment, abbreviation, keyboard key, lists, quote, link, code, table, math, thematic break, and directives. Most tools act on selected text; some insert a template at the cursor.

The editor shows line numbers and stores plain Markdown text. The tag box below the editor adds searchable Note tags. The bottom status area shows character and line counts and autosave state.

After a large edit, pause until All changes saved appears before closing the application, changing Data Location, or starting a Build.

Use Collapse sidebar beside the Logo to hide the workspace sidebar. The menu button at the upper left of the content shows it again. Notes, Books, Workshop, Library and PDF reading share this control; the desktop collapse preference is remembered across restarts. On narrow windows the sidebar opens as a drawer.
主界面可以分成四个区域。

Notes / Books 用于切换普通独立笔记和结构化 Book。按 Ctrl+Q 可以快速切换，并保留原来选中的 Note 或 Book 页面；Books 按钮内部右侧显示 Q 提示，悬停可查看 Ctrl+Q，打开对话框时不会切换工作区。

Sort by 将 Notes 列表或 Book 下拉框按 Last modified（修改时间）、Date created（创建时间，时间均为最新在前）或 Name (A–Z)（名称）排序。置顶 Notes 始终优先；两个工作区分别记住排序选择，重启后仍保留。Book 修改时间也会计入其页面正文的修改；下拉框排序不会改变 Book 内部目录和导出顺序。

Book 下拉框用于切换不同 Book，旁边的加号用于新建 Book。

+ Section 新建顶层组织页面；+ Child Page 在当前所选项目下新建子页面。

Settings、Export、Build、Publish 和 Delete 针对当前选中的 Book 操作。

下方树形目录就是 Book 的目录。点击标题开始编辑；点击页面前独立的三角形展开或折叠子页面。每本 Book 分别记住折叠状态，重启后仍保留；从 Preview 或 Build 检查跳转到页面，或新建子页面时，会自动展开其上级目录。

Light / Dark 只改变软件界面主题。

Data Location 用于查看或迁移软件数据目录。

All changes saved 表示最新文字已经写入磁盘。Edit / Preview 在 Markdown 源文和阅读预览之间切换。在 Windows 上按 Ctrl+E，在 macOS 上按 Cmd+E 可以快速切换。Export PDF 将当前 Note 或 Markdown Book 页面保存为 A4 PDF，不包含子页面。PDF 默认保存位置为 LanCarbon 根目录下与 Exports 同级的 PDFs 文件夹，安装或启动时会自动创建；仍可自行选择其他保存位置。Exports 继续用于 Book 源文件副本，已有 PDF 不会自动搬移。 Page Properties 打开导出路径和页面元数据设置。Remove from Book 会把页面移出当前 Book，但保留对应 Note。图钉和垃圾桶分别用于置顶与删除当前项目。

第一行工具负责文件和引用：Insert image、Image settings、Attach file、Resources 与 Citations。也可以把文件拖入编辑器，或直接粘贴截图。

第二行工具修改 Markdown/MyST 源文：撤销、重做、段落/标题、粗体、斜体、下划线、删除线、上标、下标、对齐、缩写、键盘按键、列表、引用、链接、代码、表格、数学公式、分隔线和 Directives。多数工具会作用于选中的文字，另一些会在光标位置插入模板。

编辑区带有行号，保存的是纯 Markdown 文本。下方标签框用于添加可搜索的 Note 标签。最底部状态区显示字符数、行数和自动保存状态。

完成较大修改后，先等待 All changes saved 出现，再关闭软件、修改 Data Location 或开始 Build。

Read 

Workshop and Library for workspace and resource guidance.

工作区与资料管理详见 

Workshop 与 Library。

点击 Logo 旁的 Collapse sidebar 可收起工作区侧栏，点击内容区左上角的菜单按钮再次展开。Notes、Books、Workshop、Library 与 PDF 阅读共用此操作，桌面侧栏状态在重启后保留；窄窗口使用抽屉式侧栏。

records.content:
Open Environment Setup from the sidebar, Build or Publish. It reports the detected version, executable location and compatibility of Python, Node.js, Jupyter Book 2, Git and GitHub CLI, plus GitHub sign-in and connectivity. Compatible system tools are marked Using existing and have no Install button. For a missing or incompatible tool, select Install managed copy. Installing Jupyter Book 2 also prepares missing managed Python and Node.js dependencies. LanCarbon shows download, verification, deployment and post-install progress, installs only below LanCarbon\Tools, and checks it again. Managed Python is portable and cannot update a registered system Python; Cancel stops work and removes partial files. Use Instructions instead if you prefer a manual system installation.

If an installation or environment check reports an error, open 

Troubleshooting Common Problems directly; you do not need to wait until the later publishing chapter.

MyST extends Markdown with scientific and technical publishing features. A role is usually inline; a directive is a block with a name, optional settings, and content.

A role appears inside a sentence and has a compact form. LanCarbon’s abbreviation, keyboard, underline, superscript, and subscript tools create supported role syntax. Preview the result immediately after insertion.

Open Directives and choose a template. Common uses include notes, warnings, figures, and other structured content. A directive uses an opening fence, a name in braces, optional lines beginning with :, body content, and a closing fence.

This is useful background information.
```

```{warning}
Back up your data before a major change.
```

Publish copies the latest successful local website to a GitHub repository branch and configures GitHub Pages to serve that branch. The first publication establishes the connection; later publications update the same website while keeping Git commit history.
Publish 会把最新成功的本地网站复制到 GitHub 仓库的发布分支，并配置 GitHub Pages 使用该分支。第一次发布负责建立连接；后续发布会更新同一个网站，并保留 Git commit 历史。

Publish talks to GitHub through several programs: the browser, GitHub CLI, Git, and LanCarbon’s GitHub API request. A proxy extension that affects only the browser may let 

github.com open while Git still fails on port 443.

If your network can reach GitHub directly, no proxy is needed. If GitHub is blocked, unstable, or repeatedly reset:

Open your trusted proxy application.

Enable system proxy / global proxy or TUN mode, according to that application’s design.

Confirm 

github.com opens in the browser.

Return to Publish and select Refresh Checks.

Confirm both GitHub API and Git HTTPS connection pass.

Publish or update while that network mode remains active.

LanCarbon does not configure or bypass network policy for you. Use only a network method permitted by your organization and location. Turn off the proxy mode afterward if that is your normal practice.

Typical network messages contain Failed to connect to github.com port 443, Connection was reset, Recv failure, timed out, ECONNRESET, or a failed OAuth access-token request. These messages usually describe connectivity, not damaged Book content.

Do not repeatedly click Publish while a connection is failing. Restore connectivity, select Refresh Checks, and retry once. GitHub may also have a service incident; check 

GitHub Status if your connection otherwise works.

典型网络错误包含 Failed to connect to github.com port 443、Connection was reset、Recv failure、timed out、ECONNRESET，或 OAuth access-token 请求失败。这些信息通常表示连接问题，不代表 Book 内容损坏。

What Publish Means and How It Differs from Build

records.content:
Build creates and checks the website on your computer. Publish transfers that checked website to GitHub and makes a public URL available through GitHub Pages.

Build

Publish

Uses Python and Jupyter Book 2

Uses Git, GitHub CLI, a GitHub account, and network access

Produces a local HTML website

Updates a GitHub branch

Can work offline for local content

Must reach GitHub services

Should happen after meaningful edits

Happens after a current successful Build

Important Git concepts for this workflow:

A repository is the online container for files and their history.

A commit is one recorded version. LanCarbon shows the short commit identifier after publishing.

A branch is one line of versions. LanCarbon normally publishes website files to gh-pages.

GitHub Pages serves the root of that branch as a website.

You do not need to type routine Git commands. LanCarbon creates, clones, updates, commits, pushes, and checks the publication branch through its workflow. Do not manually delete or rewrite gh-pages unless you understand the consequence.

Publishing does not upload the private LanCarbon data directory. It sends generated website files required by the public site. Still, review your Book for private text, images, attachment contents, metadata, and hidden pages before publishing.

本流程涉及的 Git 基本概念：

Repository（仓库） 是在线存放文件和历史记录的容器。

Commit（提交） 是一次被记录的版本。发布后 LanCarbon 会显示简短 commit 标识。

Branch（分支） 是一条版本线。LanCarbon 通常把网站文件发布到 gh-pages。

GitHub Pages 会把该分支根目录作为网站提供。

日常流程不要求你手工输入 Git 命令。LanCarbon 会在工作流中创建、下载、更新、提交、推送并检查发布分支。如果不了解后果，不要手动删除或重写 gh-pages。

Publish 不会上传整个 LanCarbon 私有数据目录，而是发送公开网站需要的生成文件。即便如此，发布前仍应检查 Book 中是否包含隐私文字、图片、附件内容、元数据或不希望公开的隐藏页面。

The status cards are a checklist:

Git and GitHub CLI: required programs and versions.

GitHub account: authenticated account name.

GitHub API: account services can be reached.

Book website build: the saved website exists and matches the current Book.

Repository binding: the connected owner/repository exists and is reachable.

Git HTTPS connection: Git can download the publication branch.

GitHub Pages: the public Pages configuration and URL.

Published website: last publication time and commit.

Before the first connection, choose Existing repository or New repository:

Owner or organization is the GitHub account or organization that owns the repository.

Repository name becomes part of the URL; use letters, numbers, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

Publication branch normally remains gh-pages.

Visibility controls repository visibility. GitHub plan and Pages rules may affect private repositories.

Connect and Initialize Pages checks or creates the repository, prepares the branch, configures Pages, and saves the binding.

After connection, the prominent action area appears above repository setup:

Update Website publishes the latest current Build; when the Book changed, follow the rebuild prompt/workflow first.

Open Pages opens the public website.

Open Repository opens the GitHub file/history page.

Change repository setup is an advanced action for connecting a different repository. It is not part of every update.

Refresh Checks reruns environment and connection checks.

Close leaves the panel.

Read the small proxy reminder before operations that contact GitHub. A red error card blocks or explains the affected action; fix that specific prerequisite rather than reconnecting an already valid repository.

状态卡片是一份检查清单：

Git 与 GitHub CLI：必要程序及版本。

GitHub account：已经认证的账号名称。

GitHub API：能否连接账号服务。

Book website build：保存的网站是否存在并与当前 Book 一致。

Repository binding：绑定的 owner/repository 是否存在并可访问。

Git HTTPS connection：Git 是否能下载发布分支。

GitHub Pages：公开 Pages 配置和网址。

Published website：上次发布时间与 commit。

第一次连接前，需要选择 Existing repository 或 New repository：

Owner or organization 是仓库所属的 GitHub 账号或组织。

Repository name 会成为网址的一部分，可使用字母、数字、连字符、句点或下划线。

Publication branch 通常保留为 gh-pages。

Visibility 控制仓库可见性。私有仓库能否使用 Pages 可能受 GitHub 套餐和规则影响。

Connect and Initialize Pages 检查或创建仓库、准备分支、配置 Pages 并保存绑定。

连接完成后，主要操作区会出现在 repository setup 上方：

Update Website 发布最新且与 Book 一致的 Build；Book 修改后，先按照界面提示/流程重新构建。

Open Pages 打开公开网站。

Open Repository 打开 GitHub 文件和历史页面。

Change repository setup 是连接其他仓库的高级操作，不是每次更新都要做。

Refresh Checks 重新执行环境与连接检查。

Close 关闭面板。

执行联网操作前，请阅读界面中的代理小字提示。红色错误卡片会阻止或解释受影响的操作；应修复对应前置条件，不要在仓库绑定已经正确时反复重新连接。
Use the exact current message and the failed status card. Fix one cause, select Refresh Checks, and retry once.

hierarchy.lvl3: A managed installation reports that the Tools folder is not writable
A managed installation reports that the Tools folder is not writable

records.content: Open Environment Setup and select Repair folder permissions. Approve the Windows confirmation if it appears, then refresh and retry. The repair applies only to LanCarbon’s managed Tools folder and does not change Notes or Books.

hierarchy.lvl3: A managed installation cannot create or rename a temporary folder
A managed installation cannot create or rename a temporary folder

records.content: Windows security software or a recently completed process may still be holding the folder. LanCarbon waits progressively longer and retries these transient errors automatically. If all retries are exhausted, close programs scanning LanCarbon\Tools, wait a moment, refresh Environment Setup, and retry. If the writable-folder card fails, repair its permissions first.

hierarchy.lvl3: Jupyter Book installation reports that Node.js is missing
Jupyter Book installation reports that Node.js is missing

records.content: Jupyter Book 2 uses a Node.js-based MyST engine. Environment Setup checks Node.js independently and can install a managed copy. Refresh the page and install Node.js, or retry Jupyter Book 2 so LanCarbon can prepare the missing dependency automatically.

hierarchy.lvl3: GitHub CLI is installed but not detected
GitHub CLI is installed but not detected

records.content: Restart LanCarbon after installation. Confirm gh --version works in a new terminal. If the terminal finds it but LanCarbon does not, reinstall GitHub CLI in its standard Windows location and restart the computer. Use the current LanCarbon release, which also checks the standard Program Files location.

hierarchy.lvl3: Sign in appears to do nothing
Sign in appears to do nothing

records.content: Check the taskbar for the visible terminal. Complete the prompts there. If necessary, run gh auth login manually and then Refresh Checks.

hierarchy.lvl3: Device authorization or OAuth token request times out
Device authorization or OAuth token request times out

records.content: The browser approval may succeed while GitHub CLI cannot exchange the code for a token. Enable system/global proxy or TUN mode, start a new sign-in, and use the new one-time code. One-time codes expire; do not reuse the old code.

hierarchy.lvl3: Failed to connect to github.com port 443, Connection was reset, or Recv failure
Failed to connect to github.com port 443, Connection was reset, or Recv failure

records.content: This is the Git HTTPS path. Enable a network mode that covers desktop programs, not only the browser. Refresh until Git HTTPS connection passes, then update. Do not reconnect the repository.

Check owner and repository spelling and confirm the signed-in account has administration access. A newly created repository or Pages configuration may need a short delay. Refresh and retry initialization. Use Existing repository for a repository already visible on GitHub.

hierarchy.lvl3: Open Pages shows only an initial README or an old page
Open Pages shows only an initial README or an old page

records.content: The repository may be initialized before the website deployment has completed. Compare the shown published commit, wait several minutes, and refresh the page without cache. Open Repository and inspect gh-pages. If no current website commit exists, run Update once after all checks pass.

hierarchy.lvl3: “Site not loading correctly” or incorrect BASE_URL
“Site not loading correctly” or incorrect BASE_URL

records.content: The website must be built for its repository path, such as /My-Book/. Rebuild and republish with the current LanCarbon release and the correct repository binding. Do not reuse HTML manually copied from a different repository. If the error returns for a newly named Book, report the Book title and repository name because base-path handling must apply to every Book.

hierarchy.lvl3: Update failed and the button is disabled
Update failed and the button is disabled

records.content: Read the card above it. An outdated Build requires Rebuild; missing authentication requires sign-in; a failed Git HTTPS check requires network recovery and Refresh Checks. The old public version remains available. The button should become available when real prerequisites pass.

hierarchy.lvl3: Publication branch could not be downloaded
Publication branch could not be downloaded

records.content: The detailed clone message usually reveals network failure, permission failure, or a missing branch/repository. Make the Git HTTPS check pass. Confirm the binding and account access. Retry; do not delete the local Book or published repository.

A dependency warning such as Node’s url.parse() deprecation may not be a Book error. Current LanCarbon filters known irrelevant warnings. Judge success by the error count, process result, and whether the website opens. Upgrade LanCarbon/Jupyter Book if a known warning persists.

hierarchy.lvl3: Export says the target folder is not empty
Export says the target folder is not empty

records.content: Choose a new empty folder. Export deliberately avoids overwriting externally managed files. Build does not need this export.

hierarchy.lvl3: Python, Node.js, Jupyter Book, Git, or GitHub CLI is missing
Python, Node.js, Jupyter Book, Git, or GitHub CLI is missing

records.content: Install the tool from its official source, restart LanCarbon, and reopen the relevant window. Build checks Python/Node.js/Jupyter Book; Publish checks Git/GitHub CLI/account/network.

hierarchy.lvl3: A public update still shows yesterday’s version

Test model 保存配置并发送小型请求，运行期间可以 Stop test。连接跟随电脑网络与系统代理，可能产生平台正常费用。

在 Chat 中选择 服务 · 模型 并发送文字。Enter 发送，Shift+Enter 换行。使用 Stop generating、Retry reply 与 Copy；支持 Markdown、代码和公式，提供的推理文字单独折叠。顶部直接显示会话标题。

New chat、Rename chat 和 Delete chat 管理本地会话。切换模型保留相关上下文，但其他模型的旧回答会标注来源，作为参考资料传递。当前模型按自己的配置 ID 回答身份问题，并独立分析新问题。回答相似不能单独证明调用了哪个模型，应查看回复记录的服务和模型；切换模型后重复同一问题时，不发送其他模型对此题的旧答案，旧记录仍保留在本地；完全独立的比较可另建会话。

SiliconFlow 地址为 https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1，OpenRouter 地址为 https://openrouter.ai/api/v1。通过 Refresh models 或平台目录获取当前准确 ID；账号可用时可以手动添加 OpenRouter 模型 meta-llama/llama-4-maverick。

密钥仍使用当前 Windows 账户加密，保存在 Config/ai-settings.json，界面只接收掩码。迁移 Windows 账户后可能需要重填；备份时保留完整 LanCarbon 文件夹（包括 Config、Cache 和 Library），另选的数据目录也需同时备份。会话位于 Data/Research/Chats/chats.json；切到 Notes 或 Books 后生成继续，关闭软件会停止生成并保存已有回复。Chat 提交会话文字与回答规范，Notes、Books 和 Library 文件不会自动附加。PDF 可在 Library 内阅读；EPUB 阅读、检索与文献工作流另行提供。

Select a configured service and model, then send text. The top heading is the conversation name. Each assistant reply records its configured service and model. Use Copy for Markdown source, Stop generating to save partial output, or Retry reply to replace the last stopped or failed reply without duplicating the question.

In a mixed-model conversation, previous replies from another model are attributed references. User questions and relevant information remain available, while the current model is instructed to answer independently. The model’s self-description is not proof of the upstream model identity. Repeating the exact question after a model switch omits earlier answers to that question from other models, while retaining them in the local transcript. For an independent comparison without any prior context, use separate new chats.

Response guidelines in AI Settings apply to future replies from every service. Old replies are retained as written. Chat history is local, and selected conversation text and guidelines go to the selected service. Use Choose sources to ask about Library documents, Notes or Book pages, with saved evidence and source navigation. Without sources, ordinary Chat does not automatically read those files. See 

Document Questions. Delete chat removes the local conversation after confirmation. Writing remains separately stored.

Expand Evidence below a document answer to inspect its original passages, locations and retrieval diagnostics. These diagnostics describe retrieval and do not certify every claim.

For account or network errors, check the service’s key, balance, permissions and computer network. A rate limit can belong to an upstream shared service pool rather than your account. Cancel an unwanted request with Stop generating or Stop test. Successful connectivity does not guarantee continued provider availability.

Use Choose sources directly above the message box to select documents for the current conversation.

Chat replies use Markdown with LaTeX: $...$ for inline formulae and $$ on separate lines for displayed formulae. Copy preserves this source; paste it into a Note and use Preview to render the formulae. Standard LaTeX delimiters are normalized for reading and copying. Plain-text equations in an old reply are not guessed or automatically rewritten; ask for a LaTeX version if needed.

Use Export PDF beside the chat title to save the entire conversation. Include Thinking is checked by default and exports all saved reasoning, even when collapsed on screen; disable it for answers only. Include cited evidence excerpts adds the original passages referenced by each reply. Model names, timestamps, source titles and locations remain included; citation labels belong to their own reply. Wait for generation to finish or stop it first. Export is offline, makes no model request and defaults to the PDFs folder. Stopped/error replies retain their partial status; exporting does not delete the chat.

Use Export to Note beside the chat title to save the complete conversation as a new editable Note and open its Preview. Include Thinking and Include cited evidence excerpts work as in PDF export. Each export creates an independent snapshot with the conversation title, questions, answers, model names, timestamps and source locations. Citation links lead to that reply’s source entries inside the Note; identical labels in different replies stay separate. Thinking and original excerpts are preserved as literal text. Wait for generation to finish or stop it first. Export happens locally without a model request. Subsequent chat messages do not automatically change an exported Note.

For academic writing, request APA author-year citations explicitly. Supplied bibliographic information supports the citation text; separate [S1] evidence links let you inspect the source. Verify any missing bibliographic details before using a reference in a manuscript.

选择已配置的服务和模型后发送文字，顶部直接显示会话名称。每条 AI 回复记录当时配置的服务和模型。Copy 复制 Markdown 原文，Stop generating 停止生成并保存已有文字，Retry reply 替换最后一条停止或失败的回复，不重复添加问题。

混合模型会话中，其他模型的旧回答会标注来源，作为参考传递。问题和相关信息保留，当前模型按要求独立分析。模型的自我介绍不能证明上游实际模型身份；切换模型后重复同一问题时，不向新模型发送其他模型对此题的旧答案，旧记录保留在本地；完全独立的比较可在不同新会话中发送同一问题。

AI Settings 的回答规范用于各服务后续回复，旧回复保持原样。会话记录保存在本机，所选会话文字与规范发送到所选服务。通过 Choose sources 可选择 Library 文献、Notes 或 Book 页面进行有引用的资料问答。未选择资料时，普通聊天不会自动读取这些内容。参阅 

资料问答。Delete chat 经确认后删除本地会话，写作内容单独保存。

展开资料回答下方的 Evidence，查看原文摘录、位置和检索诊断；这些诊断反映检索过程，不是对每个结论的正确性认证。

遇到账户或网络错误时检查平台密钥、余额、权限与电脑网络。限流可能来自上游共享服务池。用 Stop generating 或 Stop test 取消不需要的请求；连接成功并不保证平台持续可用。

点击消息输入框正上方的 Choose sources，选择当前聊天使用的资料。

聊天正文使用 Markdown，公式使用 LaTeX：行内公式用 $...$，独立公式用单独成行的 $$。Copy 保留这些源码，粘贴到 Note 后在 Preview 中呈现公式。常见 LaTeX 分隔符会统一处理以便阅读与复制；旧回答中的普通文本公式不会被猜测重写，如需转换可明确要求模型提供 LaTeX 版本。

点击聊天标题旁的 Export PDF 导出完整会话。默认勾选 Include Thinking，即使界面已折叠也会完整导出已保存的推理内容；取消勾选则只导出问答。Include cited evidence excerpts 可附加每条回复实际引用的原文摘录。逐条保留模型名称、时间及来源位置，各轮引用编号互不混淆。请先等待生成完成或停止生成；导出在本机完成，不调用模型，默认保存到 PDFs 文件夹。停止或失败的回复保留未完成标记，导出不会删除聊天。

点击聊天标题旁的 Export to Note，将完整聊天保存为新的可编辑 Note，并直接打开其预览。Include Thinking 与 Include cited evidence excerpts 的作用与 PDF 导出相同。每次导出创建独立快照，保留会话标题、问题、回答、模型名称、时间与来源位置；引用链接跳到笔记内对应回复的来源说明，不同轮次的相同编号互不混淆。Thinking 和原文摘录按原始文字保留。请先等待生成结束或停止生成；保存全程在本机完成，不调用模型，后续聊天不会自动改动已导出的 Note。

学术写作时可明确要求 APA 作者年份引用；引用文字依据资料中的书目信息，独立的 [S1] 证据链接用于核查原文。用于论文前请补齐并核对缺失的书目信息。

Open an EPUB in Library with Open or a double-click, or open its attachment from Note/Book Preview or Resources → Read EPUB. The reader uses local EPUB 2/3 chapters and navigation, with selectable text, embedded images and tables. Contents jumps to chapters or headings; previous/next buttons switch chapters. Find in EPUB (Ctrl+F) searches the book and lists up to 250 matches. Font size, line spacing and reading width are adjustable. Reading follows LanCarbon’s theme and common text layout; publisher-specific styles, scripts, audio/video, external resources, DRM and fixed-layout publications are not supported. Unsupported books can use Open externally.

Enable Translate (Ctrl+Alt+T) to translate selected English using the existing translation configuration and Usage records. Reading itself is offline and does not call AI. Chapter, scroll position and typography are saved by stable document ID in Data/Library/epub-reading.json, shared by Library and linked Note/Book attachments. Rename/move and restart preserve progress. A newer external version offers Reload latest version. The file remains unchanged; no extracted-book cache is written to disk.

PDFs and EPUBs share a top tab bar with up to 10 files. Opening the same document from another location activates its existing tab. Select a tab to return to its saved position; the active tab scrolls into view. Workspace returns to writing or Library without closing the tabs. The × on a tab closes only that file; closing the active tab selects a neighboring one. At the limit, close a tab before opening another. Arrow keys, Home and End switch tabs when a tab has keyboard focus. Tabs and the active file are restored after restart; only the active document body is loaded.

The reader uses two toolbar rows: file tabs and the sidebar toggle at the top, followed by reading controls. Open externally is beside the search box. The file name appears in its tab; Workspace returns to the previous writing or Library view while keeping file tabs open. When files are open, the sidebar toggle stays at the left of the tab row, including when the tabs are scrolled.

在 Library 中点击 Open 或双击 EPUB，或从 Note／Book 的 Preview 附件和 Resources → Read EPUB 打开。阅读器在本地读取 EPUB 2／3 的章节和目录，支持选取文字、内嵌图片与表格。Contents 跳转章节或标题，前后按钮切换章节；Find in EPUB（Ctrl+F）搜索全书并列出最多 250 条匹配。可调整字号、行距和阅读宽度。正文采用 LanCarbon 主题和统一文字排版；不支持出版物专用样式、脚本、音视频、外部资源、DRM 和固定版式书籍。无法内置阅读的书籍可使用 Open externally。

开启 Translate（Ctrl+Alt+T）后，选取英文即可沿用翻译配置与 Usage 统计。阅读本身离线运行，不调用 AI。章节、滚动位置和文字样式按稳定文档 ID 保存在 Data/Library/epub-reading.json，Library 与 Note／Book 的关联附件共用；改名、移动或重启后保留进度。外部保存新版后提供 Reload latest version。阅读不修改原件，不在磁盘建立解压后的书籍缓存。

PDF 与 EPUB 共用顶部标签栏，最多同时打开 10 个文件。从不同位置打开同一文献会切换到已有标签；切换后恢复各自位置，当前标签会自动滚动到可见处。Workspace 返回写作／Library，同时保留文件标签；标签上的 × 只关闭该文件，关闭当前标签后切换到相邻文件。达到上限后需先关闭一个标签。标签获得键盘焦点时，可用方向键、Home、End 切换。重启后恢复标签和当前文件，正文只加载当前文件。

阅读区使用两行工具栏：上方为文件标签和侧栏开关，下方为阅读操作；Open externally 位于搜索框左侧。文件名只在标签中显示，点击 Workspace 返回先前的写作或 Library 页面并保留文件标签。打开文件后，侧栏开关固定在标签行左侧，横向滚动标签时仍可操作。

This chapter explains the workspaces for research and source materials, how they connect to your writing, and how to protect your work.

Notes holds independent writing and personal ideas.

Books organizes writing into structured pages.

Library is the workspace for original materials and existing managed resources.

Workshop brings together Run, Templates, Outputs, Chat, Usage, AI Settings and Translation Settings. Availability is shown on each page; Coming soon means that the action is not enabled.

Original materials and generated drafts have separate roles. Original files belong to Library; generated Markdown belongs to Workshop Outputs. Writing in Notes and Books remains editable. Use the following pages to switch workspaces, import originals and browse resources and understand backup and recovery.

See 

Selection Translation for optional English-to-Chinese assistance across the workspaces.

See 

Token Usage and Model Costs to review local AI consumption.

本章介绍研究与原始资料工作区、它们与写作内容的关系，以及保护个人资料的方法。

Notes 用于独立写作和个人思考。

Books 将写作组织为结构化页面。

Library 用于原始资料和现有受管理资源。

Workshop 包含 Run、Templates、Outputs、Chat、Usage、AI Settings 和 Translation Settings。各页面会显示操作是否可用，Coming soon 表示尚未启用。

原始资料与生成稿分别承担不同职责：原始文件归属 Library，生成的 Markdown 归属 Workshop Outputs。Notes 和 Books 中的写作内容保持可编辑。后续页面说明工作区切换、原文导入与资源浏览，以及备份与恢复。

用量与费用统计见 

Token Usage and Model Costs。

Open Workshop → Chat. Choose a Chat model, then use Choose sources above the message box. Notes appear as a list; Books expand into chapters and pages; Library folders expand into subfolders and files. Arrows expand without selecting. Book, chapter and folder checkboxes select their contents; individual items can be excluded. Search and folding preserve selection. A source referenced more than once is counted once. Whole-Book and folder selections include later additions; chapter/page selections retain the selected pages. Include linked attachments follows references without copying Library originals. Enable Show built-in content to select the official tutorial. Import PDF / EPUB, or dropping files into Chat, imports or reuses Library originals and selects them.

Sources are remembered per chat. Clear sources returns to ordinary Chat; changing the selection excludes prior document answers from the new scope. Stop generating cancels preparation and generation. No separate Knowledge base page is required.

When Evidence shows PaperQA · full text, LanCarbon reads all available parsed text from the selected sources. Choose any configured Chat model from SiliconFlow, OpenRouter or Others. The selected service must support Chat Completions and have enough context capacity for your sources; access and context limits are determined by that service. You can switch models in the chat selector without changing your sources. Embedding and Rerank are not needed in this mode. PaperQA organizes the complete original passages for one answer; it does not generate a summary, plan, quotation map or second rewritten answer. Recent completed conversation turns from the same selection are included for follow-up questions. Each turn checks the current source texts; previous answers are conversation context, not additional evidence.

If the selected texts are too large, missing or only partly parsed, the request stops before sending. Reduce the selection or check the source/OCR; no part is silently omitted. Full text means successfully extracted text, not verified visual coverage of every table or scanned page. Sending whole texts can cost more input tokens than sending a few retrieved passages. Usage records the Chat request, including returned Thinking usage. No retrieval requests are added by this mode.

The installed application includes the local PaperQA runtime; no separate Python, Docker or WSL installation is required. Existing model connections and files are reused.

Saved retrieval connections remain available in settings and old chat records retain their retrieval labels. PaperQA full-text questions do not use these connections. For a build using the retrieval mode, configure Embedding and optional Rerank in AI Settings → Retrieval. Refresh the appropriate model catalogue, save and test the chosen model; catalogue availability does not guarantee account access. When you ask a question, extraction, changed-source checks and vector preparation run automatically. Existing vectors are reused when the text and embedding model are unchanged. Retrieval selects passages within a bounded context, so selection does not mean the whole source was sent. Evidence identifies semantic retrieval, reranking or keyword fallback. Auxiliary requests and failed attempts appear in Usage. Local text/index tools provide optional inspection and cache clearing; clearing derived indexes preserves originals and chats.

Use document questions to locate passages, explain concepts and compare studies. Before incorporating a conclusion into research, open its citation and check the original amount and unit, formula variable definitions, scenario and who owns or bears the reported loss. A local calculation can check arithmetic, but does not establish that the model selected the right entity or scenario.

Replies cite saved passages as [S1], [S2], etc. Click a citation or expand Evidence → Open source to open its PDF page, EPUB chapter, or Note/Book source lines. Evidence distinguishes cited passages from other included passages. Moving or renaming a source preserves its identity; editing or deleting the original prevents outdated navigation while retaining the saved passage. Citation checks identify unavailable sources and missing or unknown labels, not whether a model’s scientific interpretation is correct. Verify important amounts, units, methods and comparisons against the actual original.

Text extraction supports text-based/scanned PDF, reflowable EPUB and Note/Book Markdown. Scanned pages can use local English/Chinese OCR; check important numbers and formulas visually. Encrypted PDFs, DRM/fixed-layout EPUB, Word and standalone images are not supported as indexed sources. Preparation has bounded per-source and total capacity; large selections can require narrowing. Local extraction makes no model API calls. Sending a document question transmits the selected context to your configured service and incurs that service’s charges. Copies and chat exports retain the existing Markdown/LaTeX workflow; PDF and Note exports can include Thinking.

进入 Workshop → Chat，选择聊天模型，再点击输入框上方的 Choose sources。Notes 按列表显示；Books 按整本书、章节、页面展开；Library 按文件夹、子文件夹和文件展开。箭头只展开目录；勾选整书、章节或文件夹可选中其内容，也可单独排除条目。搜索和折叠保留选择，同一来源重复引用只计算一次。整本 Book 和文件夹包含之后新增的内容；章节和页面选择保留当时选中的页面。Include linked attachments 跟随附件引用，不复制 Library 原件。勾选 Show built-in content 可选择官方教程。Import PDF / EPUB 或拖入文件会导入或复用 Library 原件并选中。

资料范围按聊天保存。Clear sources 回到普通聊天；更换选择后，之前的资料回答不进入新范围。Stop generating 取消准备和生成，无需单独操作 Knowledge base 页面。

当 Evidence 显示 PaperQA · full text 时，软件读取选定资料的全部可用解析文本。可选择 SiliconFlow、OpenRouter 或 Others 中已配置的聊天模型；所选服务须支持 Chat Completions，并有足够的上下文容量，模型权限和容量以服务端为准。可在聊天模型选择框切换模型，无需重新选择资料。此模式不需要 Embedding 和 Rerank。PaperQA 将完整原文组织为一次回答的输入，不先生成摘要、规划、引文定位表或第二次改写答案。同一资料选择下近期已完成的对话可用于追问，每轮核对当前原文；以前的回答只是对话上下文，不是新的证据。

资料过大、缺失或仅完成部分解析时，会在发送前停止。请缩小选择或检查原文/OCR，不会悄悄省略一部分。全文指成功提取的文字，不代表每个表格或扫描页的视觉内容均已核验。全文输入可能比少量检索片段消耗更多输入 token。Usage 记录这一次 Chat 请求及接口返回的 Thinking 用量，此模式不额外发起检索请求。

安装版内置本地 PaperQA 运行环境，无需另装 Python、Docker 或 WSL；现有模型连接与文件可直接复用。

已保存的检索连接继续保留，旧聊天保留原来的检索标识。PaperQA 全文问答不使用这些连接。在使用检索模式的构建中，可在 AI Settings → Retrieval 配置 Embedding 和可选 Rerank。刷新相应模型目录、保存并测试；目录中可见不代表账号一定有权限。提问时自动提取文字、检查变更并准备向量；文字和嵌入模型未变时复用向量。检索在有限上下文中选择片段，选中资料并不代表整篇已发送。Evidence 显示语义检索、重排或关键词回退，辅助调用及失败请求计入 Usage。本地文本与索引工具可检查和清理缓存，清理衍生索引不会删除原件和聊天。
资料问答适合定位段落、解释概念和比较文献。将结论写入研究前，打开引用检查原文金额与单位、公式变量定义、情景及损失由谁持有或承担。本地计算可以核对算术，不能证明模型选对了主体或情景。

回答以 [S1]、[S2] 等引用保存的原文。点击引用或 Evidence → Open source 可打开 PDF 页、EPUB 章节或 Note/Book 对应行。Evidence 区分实际引用与其他已纳入的原文。移动、重命名保留来源身份；编辑或删除原件会阻止旧引用错误跳转，但聊天中保留当时的文本。来源和引用检查可识别文件不可用、标签缺失或未知，不能判定模型的学术解释是否正确。重要金额、单位、方法和比较结论应核对原文。

支持文字/扫描 PDF、流式 EPUB 和 Note/Book Markdown。扫描页可使用本地中英文 OCR，关键数字和公式仍应查看原页。加密 PDF、DRM/固定版式 EPUB、Word 和独立图片暂不作为可索引来源。单篇及总文本容量有上限，大范围选择可能需要缩小。本地解析不调用模型；发送资料问题会将选定上下文交给已配置的服务并产生费用。复制和导出沿用 Markdown/LaTeX 流程，PDF 和 Note 导出可包含 Thinking。

Checking monetary amounts / 核对金额

records.content:
Source-linked amounts: Clearly identified monetary values can be rendered and converted locally from their original source quantities. Differences and percentage reductions use those same operands without another model call. Check amounts lists calculations that could not be matched or completed; these notes remain in copies and PDF/Note exports. Unclear units and flagged OCR are not guessed. These checks cover monetary representation and arithmetic, not whether the chosen scenario, entity or economic comparison is correct.

原文金额核对： 明确识别的金额可根据原文数量在本地显示和换算，差额与降幅也由对应操作数计算，不增加模型调用。Check amounts 会列出无法匹配或完成的具体计算，复制及 PDF／Note 导出会保留这些说明。单位不清楚、OCR 存疑时不猜测换算。核对范围是金额表示和算术，不代表情景、主体或经济比较已经验证正确。

Open Library → Imports, choose a destination folder and use Import PDF / EPUB or drop local documents into the main area. Each batch accepts 20 files, 100 MB each. New folder creates an Imports subfolder; the sidebar shows the hierarchy. All files and filename search show file locations. Source materials remains the managed writing-resource collection.

Duplicate checks use exact file contents across Library and its retained versions. Import details shows the incoming filename, existing/current name, location and matching version. Importing a.pdf, renaming it b.pdf, then importing the same a.pdf reuses b.pdf and retains its name. Re-importing an old revision does not roll back the current one. Locate opens the existing entry; Move to… can move an imported original into the chosen folder.

Equal names with different contents receive numbered names in the same folder; the report shows the final name. Different folders can contain equal names. Renaming checks names in the same folder, ignores case and preserves extensions; conflicts show a suggested available name without overwriting or merging. Move preserves the document ID, writing links and versions; conflicts require Keep both as… or Cancel.

Open or double-click reads PDFs in LanCarbon; Open externally uses the default app. Images, TXT, Word and other ordinary resources use the default app. Executables, scripts and shortcuts are excluded. The app opens a named working copy under Library/.Editing; saving that file registers a new current version within a few seconds while LanCarbon runs, or after its next launch. Unchanged saves add no version. Versions lists revisions and Save version exports an earlier one; old versions remain stored locally. Saving as another file/location requires a separate import. Keep managed hash-named originals intact; use Open for editing.

Notes and Books Attach file starts in root Library. Selecting an imported original reuses it with its current display name and a stable writing reference, without copying its bytes into assets. Later rename/move/version changes keep the reference valid and use the current contents. Removing this linked resource in Resources removes its writing references while the Library original remains in Imports. Ordinary resource deletion still removes its files and versions after confirmation.

Folder reveals the managed original and Save a copy exports outside Library. Importing itself is offline and inserts no writing link. Catalogs and edit-session records live in the active Data/Library; originals, retained versions and working copies stay in root Library. Moving Data carries the records. Back up both locations, including pending working copies. After using folders, linked attachments or new versions, application rollback needs a matching data snapshot; preserve newer writing separately before restoring it.

Select an Imports folder to use Rename folder or Delete folder. Deleting a folder moves its files and subfolders to the parent, numbers conflicting names, and retains document IDs, writing links and versions. It does not delete the contents. Changes made in File Explorer within Imports are checked on startup, when returning to Library, and every few seconds: folder and document renames/moves retain identity where the original can be identified; new PDF/EPUB files are indexed locally. Deleted documents remain marked missing so references are preserved. Use Open externally to edit file contents with version history; directly overwriting managed originals is reported and requires restoration or re-import.

Batch operations: Select Batch select to show file checkboxes and the batch toolbar; the normal list keeps both hidden. Use the checkboxes or Select visible to select files in the current list or search results. Exit selection clears the checkmarks and returns to the normal list. The toolbar shows the count and offers Clear selection, Move selected, Export selected and Delete selected. Changing a folder or filter clears the selection. Built-in tutorial resources are protected and excluded from selection. Move applies to imported originals and keeps IDs, versions, references and reading positions; choose an Imports destination and whether to Keep both when names match. Export copies current versions into a chosen folder outside Library, numbering matching names without overwriting. Originals stay unchanged; per-file failures are listed and successful items are retained.

Delete on a row or Delete selected permanently removes the selected managed files and their stored versions, including missing entries. Confirmation lists all affected Note/Book references; confirming removes those links and resource settings while retaining surrounding writing. Shared files needed by unselected resources are kept. Open tabs close and external-edit tracking stops. Cancel leaves files and references untouched. Deleting an imported original in Library also removes its linked writing resource; deleting only that link in Resources continues to keep the Imports original. To remove a file completely, use Library deletion rather than deleting it in File Explorer.

hierarchy.lvl2: 导入与管理 Library 资料
导入与管理 Library 资料

records.content:
打开 Library → Imports，选择目标文件夹后 Import PDF / EPUB 或拖入本地文档。每批最多 20 个、每个 100 MB。New folder 创建 Imports 子文件夹，左侧显示目录树。All files 与文件名搜索显示所属位置；Source materials 仍用于受管理的写作资源。

在整个 Library 及保留版本中按文件字节去重。Import details 显示导入名称、已有文件当前名称、位置和匹配版本。导入 a.pdf、改名 b.pdf 后，再导入相同 a.pdf，会复用 b.pdf 并保留改名。重新导入旧版本不会回退当前版本。Locate 定位原条目；Move to… 可将导入原件移动到所选文件夹。

同文件夹内同名不同内容自动编号，报告显示最终名称；不同文件夹允许同名。重命名只检查同文件夹名称，忽略大小写并保留扩展名，冲突时提示可用名称，不覆盖或合并。Move 保留文档 ID、引用与全部版本；移动重名时明确选择 Keep both as… 或取消。

Open 或双击在 LanCarbon 阅读 PDF，Open externally 使用默认程序；图片、TXT、Word 等普通资料使用默认程序，程序、脚本和快捷方式不直接打开。软件打开 Library/.Editing 中带名称的编辑副本；保存该文件后，LanCarbon 运行时会在几秒内登记新版本，关闭期间的保存会在下次启动后处理。内容未变不新增版本。Versions 查看历史，Save version 导出旧版本；历史原件保留在本地。另存其他文件或位置需另行导入。请保持带哈希的受管理原件完整，通过 Open 进行编辑。

Notes 和 Books 的 Attach file 默认打开根目录 Library。选择导入原件时沿用当前显示名与稳定写作引用，不再把原件复制到 assets。之后改名、移动或产生新版本，引用保持有效并读取当前内容。在 Resources 删除此类关联资源时移除写作引用，原件仍在 Imports；普通资源删除仍会在确认后删除文件和历史版本。

Folder 定位受管理原件，Save a copy 将副本导出到 Library 之外。导入本身可离线完成，不自动插入写作链接。目录及编辑会话记录在实际 Data/Library，原件、历史版本和编辑副本在根目录 Library；更改 Data 携带记录。两处都需备份，包括尚未登记的编辑副本。使用子目录、关联附件或新版本后，回滚程序需要匹配的数据快照；恢复前另行保留新增写作内容。

选中 Imports 子文件夹后，使用 Rename folder 或 Delete folder。删除文件夹会把文件和子目录移到上一级，重名自动编号，保留文档 ID、写作引用与历史版本，不删除内容。在文件资源管理器中修改 Imports 后，软件会在启动、返回 Library 及运行期间每隔几秒检查：能够识别原件的文件夹或文档改名、移动会保持身份，新放入的 PDF／EPUB 会自动登记。被删除的文档保留记录并标为缺失，以保留引用。修改文件内容请使用 Open externally 以保留版本历史；直接覆盖受管理原件会提示异常，需要恢复或重新导入。

批量操作： 点击 Batch select 后才显示文件复选框和批量操作栏，普通列表默认隐藏。通过复选框或 Select visible 选取当前列表或搜索结果中的文件。点击 Exit selection 清空勾选并恢复普通列表。操作栏显示数量，并提供 Clear selection、Move selected、Export selected 和 Delete selected。切换文件夹或筛选会清空勾选；内置教程资源受到保护，不参与选取。移动仅适用于导入原件，保留 ID、版本、引用和阅读进度；选择 Imports 目标文件夹，并决定是否 Keep both when names match。导出将当前版本复制到 Library 之外的目标文件夹，重名自动编号，不覆盖已有内容，原件保持不变。逐项列出失败原因，成功结果保留。

文件行的 Delete 或 Delete selected 会永久删除选中的受管理文件及其历史版本，也可清理缺失条目。确认框列出全部 Note／Book 引用；确认后移除对应链接和资源设置，保留周围正文。其他未选资源仍需使用的共享文件会保留。相关阅读标签关闭，外部编辑跟踪停止；取消不改变文件和引用。在 Library 删除导入原件，也会移除关联的写作资源；仅在 Resources 删除关联资源，仍保留 Imports 原件。需要完整删除文件时，请使用 Library 删除功能，不要直接在文件资源管理器中删除。

Open a PDF from Library, a Note attachment or a Book attachment. Pages with usable embedded text keep that text. When the current page has no usable text layer, LanCarbon automatically recognizes its English and Simplified Chinese text on this computer.

Use the OCR menu in the PDF toolbar:

Recognize page retries the current page, including pages whose embedded text is incorrect. This explicitly selected OCR result takes priority for that page.

Recognize PDF prepares scanned pages throughout the document, up to the indexing limit of 500 pages. It reuses saved recognition results and preserves readable embedded text.

Stop OCR cancels the current reading task. Completed pages stay cached and can be reused when you continue.

After recognition, the normal PDF text layer supports selection, copying, Find in PDF, and the existing Translate switch. For a whole-document search, first use Recognize PDF or prepare that document for Chat; pages not yet recognized are not searchable as image text. If Chat recognized more pages while the reader was already open, reopen the PDF or use Recognize PDF to refresh its text layer.

Document questions automatically prepare the selected scans. Library and Note/Book references to the same PDF reuse recognition by file content and original page number. Evidence labels recognized excerpts with OCR, and the citation opens the original PDF page. Recognized text does not replace or rewrite the original PDF.

English/Chinese recognition resources are included with the application. No OCR account, API Key, download or online OCR service is required. Recognizing locally does not consume Chat, embedding or rerank tokens. When new recognized text is subsequently sent to the configured embedding or Chat services, their normal usage is recorded.

Recognition progress appears in the reader or source preparation. Confidence is a diagnostic, not a guarantee: inspect the original for important numbers, currency units, multi-column text, tables and formulas. A blurred scan, unusual layout or damaged text layer may still need manual checking. Local OCR extracts text and coordinates; it does not promise complete spreadsheet/table structure or mathematical markup.

Recognition text and coordinates are saved in Data/Research/OCR, limited to 64 MB; older derived results are removed when necessary. Full-page recognition images are released after processing rather than saved. Workshop → AI Settings → Retrieval → Local OCR → Clear OCR cache removes only derived recognition results. Original files, personal writing, saved chats and usage are retained. Needed scans will be recognized again; changing recognized text can also require updated embeddings.

Password-protected PDFs can be read after entering the password locally; automatic indexing/OCR does not retain or reuse that password. EPUB DRM and standalone image/Word recognition are outside this PDF workflow.

hierarchy.lvl2: 扫描 PDF 阅读与识别
扫描 PDF 阅读与识别

records.content:
从 Library、Note 附件或 Book 附件打开 PDF。已有可用文字层的页面继续使用原文字；当前页面没有可用文字层时，LanCarbon 会在本机自动识别英文和简体中文。

使用 PDF 工具栏的 OCR 菜单：

Recognize page 重新识别当前页，也适用于文件自带文字层错误的页面。用户明确重新识别的结果优先用于该页。

Recognize PDF 准备全文中的扫描页，最多处理索引范围内的 500 页；复用已保存的识别结果，保留可用的原文字层。

Stop OCR 停止当前阅读识别任务。已经完成的页面继续保留，后续可以复用。

识别后，原有 PDF 文字层支持选取、复制、Find in PDF 搜索和现有的 Translate 选词翻译。搜索整份扫描文档前，先使用 Recognize PDF 或让 Chat 准备该文档；尚未识别的图片文字不能直接搜索。如果 Chat 在阅读器打开期间识别了更多页面，重新打开 PDF 或执行 Recognize PDF 刷新文字层。

资料问答会自动准备选中的扫描 PDF。Library 文件和 Note／Book 对同一 PDF 的引用，按文件内容与原始页码复用识别结果。Evidence 用 OCR 标识识别片段，点击引用仍跳到原始 PDF 对应页。识别文字不会替换或改写原文件。

应用内置中英文识别资源，无须 OCR 账号、API Key、额外下载或在线识别服务。本地识别不消耗 Chat、embedding 或 rerank tokens。后续将新增识别文字交给已配置的 embedding 或 Chat 服务时，按原有规则记录用量和费用。

阅读器或资料准备过程会显示进度。置信度用于提示识别质量，不代表准确保证；重要数字、币种单位、分栏顺序、表格和公式应核对原页。模糊扫描、特殊版式和损坏文字层仍可能需要人工检查。本地 OCR 提取文字及坐标，不保证完整还原表格结构或数学公式标记。

识别文字和坐标保存在 Data/Research/OCR，最多 64 MB，达到限制后清理较早的派生结果。整页识别图片处理完即释放，不长期保存。通过 Workshop → AI Settings → Retrieval → Local OCR → Clear OCR cache 只清除识别缓存，原文件、个人写作、聊天和用量保留。再次需要时会重新识别；识别文字变化也可能需要更新向量。

加密 PDF 可在本地输入密码后阅读；自动索引和 OCR 不保存或复用该密码。EPUB DRM、独立图片和 Word 识别不属于这套 PDF 流程。

Open a PDF from Library with Open or a double-click. In a Note or Book, click its attachment in Preview, or use Resources → Read PDF. Workspace in the tab bar returns to the original writing or Library view. Open externally retains default-app editing and file versions; Other ordinary files use their default apps.

Use page numbers, previous/next, Fit width, Fit page, zoom, or Pages / Contents for on-demand thumbnails and the document’s own outline. Find in PDF (Ctrl+F) searches the document with previous/next matches. Reading position and zoom are saved by document ID in Data/Library/reading.json, so rename/move and linked writing attachments share progress. The currently open PDF is an immutable reading snapshot; a new externally saved version offers Reload latest version.

Enable the existing Translate switch (Ctrl+Alt+T), then select short English text in the PDF. Existing translation settings, cache and usage accounting apply. Scanned pages use local English/Chinese OCR. The OCR menu provides Recognize page, Recognize PDF and Stop OCR; recognized text supports selection, search and existing translation. Reading is local and does not call AI or change the file. Password-protected files prompt locally without saving the password. PDF scripts and editing are disabled. Annotation creation remains separate. The reader loads page data as needed and releases the open snapshot when closed; recognized text and coordinates are cached up to 64 MB; temporary page images and thumbnails are not saved to disk.

在 Library 中点击 Open 或双击 PDF。在 Note／Book 的 Preview 点击 PDF 附件，或通过 Resources → Read PDF 打开；标签栏的 Workspace 返回原来的写作或文件列表。Open externally 保留默认程序编辑和文件版本功能，其他普通文件继续使用默认程序。

使用页码、前后翻页、Fit width、Fit page、缩放，以及 Pages / Contents 中按需生成的缩略图和原文目录。Find in PDF（Ctrl+F）提供全文搜索与前后匹配。阅读位置和缩放按文档 ID 保存在 Data/Library/reading.json；改名、移动及写作附件共用进度。正在阅读的内容保持为打开时的版本，外部保存新版后，可选择 Reload latest version。

开启现有 Translate（Ctrl+Alt+T），选取 PDF 中的短英文即可翻译，沿用翻译配置、缓存和用量统计。扫描页使用本地中英文 OCR；OCR 菜单提供 Recognize page、Recognize PDF 和 Stop OCR，识别文字支持选词、搜索及现有翻译。阅读本身离线运行，不调用 AI、不修改原件。加密文件在本地输入密码，密码不保存；禁用 PDF 脚本和编辑。新建批注另行提供。页面按需读取，关闭后释放打开快照，识别文字与坐标缓存最多 64 MB，不长期保存整页图片或缩略图。

hierarchy.lvl1: Backing Up and Recovering Your Work
Backing Up and Recovering Your Work

records.content:
Before an upgrade or a major move:

Wait for All changes saved, then close LanCarbon.

Back up the actual Data Location and Config. Include root Library and any Builds, Exports or PDFs you need to keep.

Keep a known working installer with the backup.

Verify that the backup can be read and restored into a separate folder before replacing your daily installation.

Application recovery and data recovery work together. An older application may require the matching data snapshot. Restoring a snapshot returns to the backup date; preserve any newer edits separately first. Use an empty recovery folder so existing work is not overwritten.

The built-in tutorial is system-managed. Its official content is synchronized on startup; your personal Notes and Books are the material to preserve in a writing backup. A backup is not a way to retain edits to the system tutorial.

If LanCarbon reports an unsupported workspace format, close it and use a compatible application or a verified recovery copy. Keep the original data until recovery has been checked.

hierarchy.lvl1: Backing Up and Recovering Your Work
Backing Up and Recovering Your Work

records.content:
升级或大规模迁移前：

等待 All changes saved，然后关闭 LanCarbon。

备份实际 Data Location 和 Config，一并包含根目录 Library，以及需要保留的 Builds、Exports 或 PDFs。

将已知可用的安装包与备份一起保存。

覆盖日常安装前，先验证备份可读，并能恢复到独立目录。

恢复程序和恢复数据需要配合。旧程序可能需要对应的数据快照。恢复快照会回到备份时的状态，请先另行保留后续新增编辑。使用空的恢复目录，避免覆盖已有内容。

内置教程由软件管理，官方内容会在启动时同步；写作备份应保护用户自行创建的 Notes 和 Books。备份不能用于保留对系统教程的自行修改。

如果 LanCarbon 提示不支持当前工作区格式，请关闭软件，使用兼容程序或经过验证的恢复副本；恢复检查完成前保留原始数据。

Open Workshop → AI Settings → Retrieval. Embedding and optional Rerank have separate service/model choices. Use an existing connection reuses a saved Chat or translation key without changing its Chat model list. Separate retrieval connection stores an independent encrypted key; choose SiliconFlow, OpenRouter or Others. Others accepts an HTTPS API base address and exact model ID. Embedding requires a compatible /embeddings endpoint with float vectors; Rerank requires /rerank with indexed relevance scores. A service may offer only one of these endpoints. Model IDs and account permissions must match the service.

Select an Embedding service and model, enable Enable semantic retrieval, and save. SiliconFlow model examples are BAAI/bge-m3 and Pro/BAAI/bge-m3. Consult your service’s current catalogue for availability and prices. The suggestions are not an account-access check.

Optionally enable Use reranking, select its connection and model, and save. SiliconFlow examples are BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 and Pro/BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3. Embedding and Rerank may use the same connection or different services/keys. Removing an independent key affects the retrieval roles sharing that connection and preserves Chat settings.

Test Embedding sends a built-in English sentence and checks vector dimensions. Test Rerank sends a built-in question and two short examples. Both use normal service billing and are recorded under their corresponding Usage purposes. Stop cancels a test or active retrieval task. Saving alone makes no model request.

In Workshop → Usage → Model prices, configure each retrieval model’s input price per million tokens and set output to zero. For a model currently offered free, set both to zero. Provider-reported token counts and charges are used when available; missing usage remains unknown. Failed attempts and retries remain recorded. Reusing a connection automatically uses its existing billing account; independent retrieval connections can be grouped with Chat/translation in Connections sharing this balance. Keep a paid account tracked when only some of its models are free.

Index tools is an optional advanced panel. It prepares vectors only for current cached source text. Unchanged passage text is reused; changed/deleted or deselected sources are excluded from retrieval. A changed Embedding service/model has a separate vector space and needs preparation again. Local keyword ranking and semantic ranking are combined; optional Rerank orders the candidate passages. Retrieval check displays source passages and positions without generating a Chat answer. If semantic retrieval or reranking fails, the panel explicitly identifies the fallback and any incomplete preparation.

Preparing sources sends their extracted text to the selected Embedding service. A search sends the question to Embedding and selected candidate passages to Rerank when enabled. Ordinary writing and local keyword search with semantic retrieval off make no retrieval requests. Retrieval follows the computer’s network and system proxy. Query instructions are normally blank; Qwen3 Embedding receives its standard retrieval query instruction automatically, and document text is not prefixed.

Vectors use a bounded 128 MB local cache in Data/Research/Retrieval, with up to 40,000 passages and 8,192 dimensions. No local model files are downloaded. Clear vector index removes vectors while keeping original files and extracted text; preparing again may incur service charges. Clearing the text index also clears its vector cache. Completed batches survive stop/restart; an interrupted task is resumed explicitly with Prepare. Data Location carries the derived cache. Chat automatically prepares its selected sources when you send a question. Refresh Embedding models and Refresh Rerank models fetch role-specific catalogues without changing Chat models; save and test your selected IDs. See 

Document Questions.

打开 Workshop → AI Settings → Retrieval。Embedding 和可选的 Rerank 分别选择服务与模型。Use an existing connection 复用已保存的 Chat 或翻译密钥，不修改 Chat 模型列表；Separate retrieval connection 保存独立的加密密钥，可选 SiliconFlow、OpenRouter 或 Others。Others 填入 HTTPS API 基础地址及准确模型 ID。Embedding 需要兼容 /embeddings 的浮点向量接口；Rerank 需要兼容 /rerank、返回输入序号及相关分数的接口。同一服务可能只支持其中一种接口，模型 ID 和账号权限须以平台为准。

选择 Embedding 服务和模型，勾选 Enable semantic retrieval 并保存。SiliconFlow 模型示例为 BAAI/bge-m3、Pro/BAAI/bge-m3；可用性和价格请查平台当前目录，软件建议列表不代表账号一定有调用权限。

按需勾选 Use reranking，选择其连接和模型并保存。SiliconFlow 示例为 BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3、Pro/BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3。两类模型可共用连接，也可使用不同服务或密钥。删除独立密钥只影响共用该连接的检索角色，保留 Chat 配置。

Test Embedding 发送一条内置英文句子并检查向量维度；Test Rerank 发送内置问题和两条短例文。测试按平台规则计费，分别记入对应的 Usage 用途；Stop 可取消测试或正在执行的检索任务。仅保存设置不会请求模型。

在 Workshop → Usage → Model prices 设置每个检索模型每百万输入 tokens 的价格，输出价格设为零。平台当前免费的模型将输入和输出均设为零。优先使用平台返回的 tokens 和费用，缺失用量保留为未知；失败尝试和重试照实记录。复用连接自动沿用原余额账户；独立检索连接可在 Connections sharing this balance 与 Chat／翻译归入同一计费账户。仅部分模型免费时，保留付费账户的余额跟踪。

Index tools 是可选的高级工具，为已缓存且成功提取的文本准备向量。未变化片段直接复用；修改、删除或取消选取的资料退出检索。更换 Embedding 服务或模型后使用独立向量空间，需要重新准备。系统结合本地关键词排名和语义排名，并可用 Rerank 重排候选片段。Retrieval check 展示资料片段及位置，不生成 Chat 回答；语义检索、重排失败或资料尚未准备完整时会明确提示降级情况。

准备资料会将提取的正文发送给所选 Embedding 服务；检索将问题发送给 Embedding，启用 Rerank 时再发送候选片段。普通写作及关闭语义检索后的本地关键词搜索不调用检索 API；网络沿用电脑的网络与系统代理。Query instructions 通常留空，Qwen3 Embedding 自动使用标准检索问题指令，不给资料正文添加指令前缀。

资料问答。

Select at most 1,600 characters / 250 words. Only the selection and translation instructions are sent, without the whole Note, Book or Chat. New selections cancel earlier translation requests. Cancellation cannot undo charges already incurred upstream.

Configure the translation model’s price in Model prices when the service does not report costs. Dedicated keys have masked previews and Remove translation key; blank key inputs retain the saved key.

Translation appears progressively as the service sends text. The waiting timer distinguishes waiting from receiving text. Use Stop to cancel or Retry translation after a failure; retries are manual. Clicking without selecting another passage does not stop translation. Partial or failed results are not saved in the cache. The service may still take time to send its first text.

After Test translation, expand Response time to compare local request setup, waiting for the first translated text, and total time. This uses the same test request and sends no extra request.

单次最多 1,600 字符／250 词，仅发送选取内容与翻译要求，不附带整篇 Note、Book 或聊天。新的选取取消旧翻译请求；取消不能撤销上游已经发生的费用。

Token activity has its own dates, independently of the summary/request filters above. Hourly defaults to today and shows 24 square cells centered in three rows of eight (00–07, 08–15, 16–23); choose another day using its calendar. Daily defaults to the current full year, with 365/366 cells arranged by week and labeled by month; select a different year independently. Changing From / To or Today / Last 7 days / Last 30 days changes summaries and request records without switching activity mode or dates. Source, model and purpose filters apply to both. From, To and the hourly day use the LanCarbon-themed calendar; dates can also be typed as YYYY-MM-DD. The legend separates zero usage and eight positive token levels. Darker cells in Light theme and brighter cells in Dark theme mean more tokens; logarithmic bands keep lower-volume activity visible. Hover or focus for time/date, tokens and CNY cost; missing data stays unknown.

In Model prices, choose a configured model and save its input/output rates per million tokens and original currency. Optional cache rates use the input rate when blank; enter zero for a verified free model. Saved prices can be edited. Removing a model and saving its configuration, deleting a service, or changing its API address automatically removes obsolete prices. Historical requests retain their own price snapshots and original reported charges.

Set 1 USD = CNY → Save exchange rate to choose a local display reference (default 7, not a live quote). USD fees are converted and combined with CNY fees for display; changing this rate updates historical CNY display values without changing original charges. Hover a cost for its original currency and Reported/Estimated source. Reported costs come from the API; estimates use the price saved when the request started. The platform statement remains authoritative.

Viewing Usage works offline and does not call a model. Local logs are in Data/Research/Usage, prices and exchange rate in Config/ai-pricing.json. Logs contain no keys or conversation bodies; model/chat deletion does not erase history. Use Purpose: Translation for translation and its tests. Locally reused translations do not add requests or tokens. Only recorded LanCarbon calls are included, without backfilling older chats or other apps.

At the top of Workshop → Usage, use Set balance / Update balance to name a billing account and select Connections sharing this balance. Select only connections billed to the same account: different chat and dedicated translation API keys may share one account, while separate accounts on the same platform should stay independent. Each connection belongs to at most one account. Enter the full current balance in CNY or USD; never add existing card balances together. Only fees recorded after calibration are deducted across the selected connections, models, chat, tests and translation. Pending requests count when their fees arrive. Reported charges take priority over request-time price estimates; unknown fees stay unknown. Update balance prefills the current estimated remaining balance. Keep the amount unchanged when only renaming the account; saving preserves the original calibration and any fees completed while editing. Edit the amount to calibrate a new platform balance. After changing shared connections, explicitly enter the full current balance again to confirm the new checkpoint.

Choose Unlimited · No balance tracking for a free service or an account that needs no balance reminders. No amount is required; token and cost statistics continue unchanged. For tracked balances, reminders appear strictly below CNY 5 or USD 2, based on currency rather than interface language. After a top-up or regrouping, enter the full current account balance to start a new checkpoint. Other accounts that lose connections need recalibration; unchecked connections become separate entries. Historical usage and fees are never moved, deleted or charged again. Stop tracking clears the checkpoint while preserving shared membership and usage. Cards are independent of Usage filters. Existing separate balances are retained until you explicitly regroup them. Records live in Data/Research/Usage/balances.json and travel with Data Location. Other apps’ charges or platform credits require manual recalibration; no balance API is called. Cross-currency deductions use the exchange rate saved in Model prices.

Welcome. This book is for a reader who has never used Jupyter Book, MyST Markdown, Git, or GitHub Pages. By the end, you will create a Book in LanCarbon, write and organize its pages, check it as a local website, and publish it online.

You do not need to learn programming. LanCarbon keeps your writing in its own local data folder and presents the important actions as buttons. The supporting tools do specific jobs: Python and Jupyter Book turn your Book into a website; Git and GitHub CLI send that website to GitHub; GitHub Pages makes it public.

Follow the four sections in order for your first Book:

Install LanCarbon and understand the tools.

Create, write, preview, and optionally export a source copy.

Build and inspect the website on your computer.

Connect GitHub, publish the website, and update it later.Write in LanCarbon → Build locally → Publish to GitHub Pages → Update when needed
